subject.title: browser tool: include current page URL in before_tool_call params for act/type actions

question: Should browser `before_tool_call` hooks receive a policy-safe current tab URL for `act`/`type`, and should that be exposed as enriched hook params or as an explicit browser state helper?
rationale: The missing URL blocks domain-pinned credential checks, but the API shape determines what browser state third-party plugins can observe and must preserve URL redaction, SSRF, and profile privacy boundaries.

options.title: Expose policy-safe hook URL
options.body: Add an additive, documented hook-time browser URL contract that reuses existing safe route URL semantics and fails closed when the URL cannot be safely resolved.

options.title: Add a scoped query helper
options.body: Keep `event.params` unchanged and provide a browser-state helper that hooks can call when a policy check needs the current URL.

options.title: Keep plugin-local caching
options.body: Leave core unchanged and require credential plugins to maintain fail-secure tab URL caches from navigate/open and after-tool-call results.

recommendation.title: Expose policy-safe hook URL
recommendation.body: Add an additive, documented hook-time browser URL contract that reuses existing safe route URL semantics and fails closed when the URL cannot be safely resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest sampled ownership history for the browser plugin and route surfaces that would define this contract.
